name: Medicine Ball Push-Up
steps: Grip the sides of a firm medicine ball on the floor and step your feet back into a high plank.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes tightly to keep your body stable over the narrow base.
Bend your elbows close to your ribs to lower your chest smoothly toward the top of the medicine ball.
Press forcefully through both hands to extend your arms back to the starting plank position.
tips: Widen your feet slightly if you need extra side-to-side stability on the ball.
Keep your hips level and prevent your wrists from rolling inward as you press.
